title: Prism + Topaz (damage spells)
problem: Uses the *target's* Defense as the potency stat.
notes: Fix: S: read the caster's Defense slot 2026-10-26: built as byte patch SU-0015 (verified against the baseline exe; not yet run in game).

release_notes.effect: Prism and Topaz spell gem properties (damage spells)
release_notes.intended: The spell's potency is based on the caster's Defense.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, on damage spells the game used the target's Defense.
release_notes.fix: Now damage spells use the caster's Defense, like the other spell types.
